column1: # Declared fault sites for the xlang virtual-malloc arm (xlang/virtual/run-virtual.py), written BEFORE its first run.
# Source: host ASan on each shim as the virtual arm builds it (cc -O0 -g -fsanitize=address, the shim plus its mock), 2026-10-22:
# frame #0's function; plus memcpy where ASan's reported source line is an explicit memcpy() call: ASan names the caller
# there, while the virtual profile's memcpy is a separate runtime function the same copy would fault inside. No site for the
# stack use-after-return row: ASan reports a null SEGV there (stack-use-after-return detection is off), not the defect.
